A '''neutrino hybridizer''' was a delicate and critical component in the sub-[[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]] [[SRB42 sublight engine/Legends|drive]] of a certain vintage and class of [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. This device was commonly constructed of [[Silicon/Legends|silicon]].
